description:
About the job

The salary range for this role is 2,500 - 3,333 USD per month (Gross in USD) 

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated AI Engineer I who is best in class, with a high IQ and a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with strong prospects for continued growth and increased ownership.

As an AI Engineer I on the Applied AI team, you will contribute to the development of platforms and systems that power Sezzle's AI-driven capabilities. Your work will span initiatives such as building AI-powered features, developing intelligent automation and agentic systems, and embedding AI solutions into customer-facing products, internal tools, and operational workflows.

You will work closely with senior engineers and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities where AI can drive meaningful impact—whether that's enhancing the customer experience, improving decision-making, or automating complex workflows. This role is ideal for engineers early in their AI careers who want hands-on exposure to production-grade AI systems, with opportunities to grow into greater ownership and technical leadership over time.

What You'll Do:


Contribute to the design and development of AI-powered platforms and systems, working alongside senior engineers on complex initiatives.
Own end-to-end delivery of complex projects, from problem discovery and system design through production rollout and iteration.
Build AI-driven features, intelligent automation, and agentic systems that enhance customer experiences and improve team productivity.
Embed AI capabilities into existing team workflows, products, and processes, ensuring solutions integrate naturally
Integrate AI capabilities into customer-facing products, internal tools, and operational workflows.
Build full-stack components spanning backend services, APIs, data layers, and frontend interfaces.
Translate business and operational problems into maintainable, AI-enabled technical solutions with guidance from senior team members.
Apply systems thinking to ensure reliability, performance, and security across platforms.
Collaborate with engineers, teams, and stakeholders across the company to understand requirements and deliver impactful solutions.
Participate in production support and incident response for team-owned systems, learning operational best practices.
Engage in code reviews and knowledge sharing to continuously improve skills and contribute to team growth.
Familiarity with Braze or similar consumer facing CRM platforms and/or various B2C digital marketing channels like affiliate, CTV, paid social, paid search, GEO/SEO, DSP.


What We'll Look For:


1–3 years of professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, or related roles.
Hands-on experience designing, building, and shipping AI-powered systems into production environments.
Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and frontend frameworks such as React.
Proven experience designing and owning production-grade full-stack systems.
Experience working with distributed systems, internal platforms, or complex data workflows.
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous problem spaces and drive solutions with minimal direction.


Preferred Qualifications:


Exposure to building AI-powered platforms or products, including contributing to architectural decisions.
Foundational knowledge of core machine learning and data science principles, including supervised/unsupervised learning, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
Familiarity with transformer architectures (BERT, GPT, etc.) and basic understanding of attention mechanisms, tokenization, and fine-tuning concepts.
Exposure to embeddings and vector representations, including text embeddings and similarity search concepts; interest in vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or similar).
Familiarity with NLP techniques such as text classification, named entity recognition, or semantic search.
Familiarity with real-world agentic frameworks workflow engines (e.g., in-house automation platforms, langchain/graph, n8n, Make, or similar), with a solid understanding of how they work under the hood.
Experience developing AI-assisted or agentic systems that interact with tools, data, or workflows.
Familiarity with cloud-native development using AWS.
Experience with containerized systems and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows (e.g., GitLab).
Experience with Golang is a plus (or willingness to learn).


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

About the job

Growth Marketing Lead (Shopify, Product Launch, Paid Traffic) 

Language: The role is in English. Only resumes in English will be accepted. 
Salary: $25,000 - $50,000 MXN / month depending on experience, paid directly via Wise / PayPal / Payoneer / Crypto etc. 
Hours: Full-time. Flexible, but available 10:00am–6:00pm EST. 
Location: Fully remote. 




Role Summary 

NCL (Natural Cure Labs) is hiring a D2C Growth Lead to own our Shopify channel end to end: conversion, funnels, offers, paid traffic, and the D2C side of every product launch. This is a senior, high-ownership role. You inherit a working channel from a 5-year operator and are expected to run it, then grow it. You report directly to the CEO. 

What makes this role different: we are launching 5–6 new products across 2026, and the D2C launch machine is yours to build. You will design tripwire funnels, upsell paths, and launch offers, and you are expected to use AI and automation daily to operate like a team of three. What's hard about it: small team, no playbook handed to you, and full accountability for a revenue number. If you want a role where someone else sets the strategy, this is not it. 




About NCL (Natural Cure Labs) 

NCL is a fast-growing dietary supplement company dedicated to delivering high-quality, science-backed products that empower healthier lifestyles. This role offers a unique opportunity to work directly with the CEO and grow alongside the company. 




Mission: To empower individuals on their wellness journey by providing high-quality, naturally derived supplements supported by research. 




Vision: To enable a culture of wellness, where individuals make informed choices and have access to natural products to live healthy, confident, and fulfilled lives.

Take ownership of Amazon (currently unowned) once Shopify is stable 
Evaluate secondary channels (eBay, Walmart, Target) with a business case

Shopify conversion rate improved by 50% within 12 months 
Every 2026 product launch ships with a complete, live D2C funnel on launch day 
At least one new tripwire or upsell funnel tested per month, with documented results 
Amazon channel ownership taken on by day 90 
Weekly channel report delivered without being chased; CEO involvement in D2C execution reduced by 5+ hours/week 




Key Skills & Experience 

5+ years in D2C e-commerce growth, with 3+ years hands-on Shopify 
AI-native: you already work with ChatGPT/Claude and automation tools daily 
Proven traffic and conversion experience you can show with numbers 
Built and shipped funnels: tripwires, post-purchase upsells, landing page sequences

High ownership, low ego, execution-focused

As a personalization agency, we bridge the gap between creative, marketing, and strategy. We specialize in cross-channel content strategy, creation, and distribution (email, paid social, push, SMS), and MarTech implementations. We work with 50+ clients, ranging in size from companies like YETI, Upside, and Nutrafol to established marquee brands like A+E Networks, Afterpay, and Stanley Black & Decker.

Role: To help us handle our increasing workload, we are looking to bring on a Senior Marketing Automation Specialist.

The ideal candidate is someone who has an interest in email production and is looking to gain experience in working on several top-tier marketing platforms and developing into a CRM career.

The candidate will be expected to work on a wide variety of projects with differing code structures. In addition to working directly inside the HTML, the candidate will also develop the CSS styling and implement platform-specific code to incorporate dynamic logic inside the template. Once the coding is completed, the candidate will QA and test in various marketing platforms with our clients directly.

In addition to coding, the candidate will work directly in implementing programs inside each platform, by making mock API calls directly via a tool such as Postman and will grasp how to make the program handle any edge cases and filter users into different flows as required.

Responsibilities:


Produce email templates and push notifications using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for a wide variety of clients. 
Collaborate with our team of highly skilled email developers and customer success managers to resolve potential issues in email deployments. 
Participate in email stand-ups to prioritize workload and ensure timely completion of all tasks. 
Work closely with the client team to field requests, answer questions, and collaborate on work-in-progress tasks. 
Ensure that emails comply with clients' standards, email marketing best practices, and CAN-Spam laws. 
Test email messages to ensure proper formats and templates are utilized using tools such as Litmus and Email on Acid. 


Minimum requirements to be considered:


5+ years of email production and development experience. 
Mastery of HTML and CSS specific to email. 
Proficiency with JSON. 
Knows what an API is, how it works, and is proficient in making GET and POST calls. 
Understand how a data feed works.

The ideal candidate:


Platform experience with Iterable, Braze, Klaviyo, Marketo, Simon Data, or Blueshift. 
Knowledge of Liquid or Python, Handlebars, Django, or JINJA. 
Proficiency with Photoshop and Figma.

Agentic Delivery: Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.

About the job

Project Lead

Job Details

Role: Project Lead (performance marketing)

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!



About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

Joining the Performance Department (performance marketing) as our Project Lead, you'll be responsible for providing stability within your team by supporting your direct manager through mentoring, training, and developing team members. You will also apply expert-level strategic thinking to promote sustainable project growth, ensuring long-term success in performance marketing initiatives.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Making expert-level project contributions, autonomously leading projects of varying complexity to a high standard of quality, with a focus on testing and creative problem solving, maintaining client success where applicable and reasonable while supporting others around you and teaching others to do the same.
Client: Exemplifying Thrive's standards for client success through strong day-to-day communication, agile and proactive problem solving, project management, and anticipating client needs.
People: Accountable for training and developing team members to be world-class performance marketers with Thrive's standards of quality and impact to aid in the growth of company performance expertise.
Company: Understands and takes action to be a key influencer and innovator in helping Thrive improve our products and services, and enhancing team member contributions while aligning individual contributions with the wider team or program objectives.


We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s mission, values, and processes, complete your technical onboarding bootcamp, and onboard onto your team, emphasizing on building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll put your learning, skills, and experiences into action by supporting on assigned client accounts, preparing and leading client calls, and helping your Strategist manage projects end-to-end.
In your first 90 days you’ll have become integrated into the team, becoming an efficient contributor and trusted partner to your assigned clients and team members. You’re starting to train others on the work we do. 


Qualifications


You have executed, maintained, and scaled performance marketing accounts of $100k-200k USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time including Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others.
You have experience directly collaborating with and supporting team members to achieve project & team goals. You have coached, mentored, or trained people before, helping them reach their career development goals.
You have advanced analytical skills and experience using data visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools. You have built your own dashboards before, or automated some manual reporting to make it more efficient. 
You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, lead gen, etc), and have been responsible for leading projects end-to-end, including delegation to more junior team members.
You have successfully managed and grown client relationships via weekly touchpoint meetings and asynchronous communication, and were able to make strategic recommendations that helped grow their business in the form of quarterly planning meetings or similar.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

About The Company

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As part of DiDi's Entrega business line, B2C is a brand-new, high-potential service offering. We provide last-mile delivery solutions for businesses, fulfilling orders coming directly from their own channels (app, website, or phone). As a Senior Analyst, you will be the analytical backbone of this rapidly scaling business unit. You will bridge the gap between complex data and real-world business growth. This role is a unique hybrid of data analytics, merchant operations, and product strategy—you will not only find the "why" behind the numbers but also design the "how" to overcome business challenges.

In this role, you'll be...


Data Monitoring & Deep-Dives: Own the daily monitoring of merchant performance, volume growth, and operational health. Perform rigorous, deep-dive root-cause analyses on data anomalies, such as volume drops, or SLA breaches.
Qualitative Merchant & User Research: Lead structured interviews and feedback sessions with merchants and end-users to gather qualitative insights, ensuring we understand the story behind the data.
Translating Insights into Action: Synthesize data metrics and qualitative feedback into concrete operational action plans and structured product capability requests to continuously improve the B2C offering.
Delivery Ops Collaboration: Partner closely with the core Entrega Delivery Operations team to improve fulfillment rates, and ensure our logistics capabilities match our merchants' high expectations.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Experience: 2+ years of highly analytical experience within a tech platform, management consulting firm, O2O/Logistics startup, or business operations environment.

Startup Mindset: A curious and detail-oriented problem solver who takes full ownership of results. You have stellar task-management skills to navigate multiple moving parts, ensuring no task or follow-up falls through the cracks in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
Comunication & Language: Exceptional communication and presentation skills. Fluent to native proficiency in both English and Spanish is required for working effectively within our international and cross-cultural matrix environment



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

About the job

一、岗位职责（Position Summary）

我们正在寻找一位兼具品牌意识与数字营销能力的品牌运营专员，负责品牌内容运营、品牌资产建设及数字营销项目执行，持续提升品牌影响力、专业信任度及市场获客能力。

该岗位前期将参与海外品牌及数字化运营项目，在实践中系统学习品牌管理、数字营销及项目运营，并逐步承担品牌策划、品牌资产建设及重点品牌项目运营工作。

________________________________________

二、岗位职责（Key Responsibilities）

（一）品牌内容运营与品牌资产建设（约35%）

负责品牌内容策划、运营及品牌资产沉淀，包括但不限于：

• 产品价值主张（Value Proposition）梳理与内容表达 

• 产品介绍、宣传资料、销售工具包策划与优化 

• 临床案例、专家观点、白皮书等专业内容整理 

• 官网文章、行业文章、品牌宣传内容策划 

• 品牌信息屋（Brand Messaging）、FAQ、品牌内容库建设 

• 持续沉淀品牌案例、品牌故事及可复用品牌资产 

能够将专业医疗内容转化为客户易理解、易传播、具有品牌价值的内容。

________________________________________

（二）品牌数字化运营（约30%）

负责品牌数字化运营及基础营销工作，包括：

• 官网内容运营及维护 

• SEO（Search Engine Optimization） 

• GEO（Generative Engine Optimization） 

• AI搜索内容优化 

• Landing Page内容优化 

• 网站数据分析及持续优化 

协助提升品牌官网流量、搜索排名及内容质量。

________________________________________

（三）品牌传播项目运营（约20%）

参与重点品牌项目的整体传播与运营，包括：

• 新品上市 

• 学术合作 

• 临床案例 

• KOL合作 

• 公益项目 

• 展会传播 

• 品牌Campaign 

协助制定传播计划，完成内容策划、项目执行、传播复盘及品牌资产沉淀。

________________________________________

（四）数字营销与增长支持（约15%）

协助开展数字营销项目，包括：

• Google Ads 

• Meta Ads 

• LinkedIn Ads 

参与广告素材准备、数据监测、Lead Tracking、MQL统计及营销数据分析，持续提升市场获客效率。

________________________________________

三、任职要求（Requirements）

教育背景

本科及以上学历。

市场营销、品牌传播、新闻传媒、英语、国际商务、生物医学工程、口腔医学、医疗器械等相关专业优先。

________________________________________

工作经验

2年以上品牌运营、数字营销、品牌传播或海外市场相关工作经验。

具有以下行业经验优先：

• 医疗器械 

• 数字化口腔 

• 生物科技 

• 医疗健康 

• SaaS 

• 高科技ToB企业 

________________________________________

专业能力

能够独立完成品牌内容策划及英文内容输出。

熟悉以下部分工作内容：

• 官网运营 

• SEO / GEO 

• 社交媒体运营 

• 内容营销 

• Google Analytics 

• Search Console 

了解Google Ads、Meta Ads、LinkedIn Ads等数字营销工具。

英语可作为工作语言，具备良好的英文写作能力。

________________________________________

四、我们更看重以下能力（Core Competencies）

1、品牌意识（★★★★★）

能够理解品牌定位及品牌价值。

能够判断内容是否符合品牌调性。

能够从客户视角思考品牌传播，而不仅仅完成内容制作。

________________________________________

2、主动思考能力（★★★★★）

能够主动发现品牌传播机会。

能够主动提出品牌传播建议。

能够围绕业务目标思考品牌价值，而不是等待任务安排。

________________________________________

3、Storytelling能力（★★★★☆）

能够将专业技术、产品特点、临床数据及案例转化为客户易理解、愿传播的品牌内容。

________________________________________

4、数字营销能力（★★★★☆）

具备一定数字营销思维。

能够根据数据不断优化内容及运营策略。

________________________________________

5、项目管理能力（★★★★☆）

能够同时推进多个项目。

具备较好的时间管理、沟通协调及跨部门协同能力。

能够主动推进项目，而不是等待安排。

________________________________________

五、加分项（Nice to Have）

具有海外留学或海外工作经历。

熟悉欧美市场文化及商业环境。

具有Google Ads、Meta Ads、LinkedIn Ads实操经验。

具有Canva、Figma、Adobe系列设计工具或视频剪辑工具使用经验。

熟悉ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity、Midjourney等AI工具，并能够应用于品牌内容生产及数字营销。

具有品牌战略、品牌咨询、品牌管理相关学习经历或项目经验。

具有Vibe Coding、No-code工具使用经验者优先。

________________________________________

六、我们希望你成为这样的人

我们寻找的，不仅是一位能够完成品牌运营工作的同事，更是一位具有品牌经营意识和成长潜力的人。

希望你：

• 对品牌建设充满兴趣； 

• 乐于研究客户、市场及产品； 

• 愿意主动发现问题并推动解决； 

• 能够持续沉淀品牌资产，而不仅完成一次传播； 

• 愿意通过实践逐步成长为能够独立负责品牌板块的品牌经理。 

________________________________________

七、你将在这里获得什么

• 深度参与全球品牌建设及数字化营销实践； 

• 系统学习品牌战略、品牌管理及品牌运营方法论； 

• 与产品、销售、研发、学术及国际团队紧密协作； 

• 参与国内外重点品牌项目及新品上市；

description:
About the job

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Customer Impact sits at the intersection of customer experience and engineering accountability. As an Associate on the Bug Review team, you will investigate flawed user experiences, verify and escalate bugs through structured cross-functional workflows, and drive visibility on open platform issues so resolution doesn't stall. Bug Review is the triage layer to separate signal from noise, ensuring Engineering receives verified, credible escalations instead of a flood of unvetted reports.

The Bug Review Associate is the front line of that triage layer. You'll investigate incoming bug reports, verify reproducibility and impact, and manage tickets through their Jira lifecycle, turning raw customer signal into evidence Engineering can act on. This is a high-volume, detail-driven role: you'll work a defined queue of tickets each day, applying consistent investigation standards so that what reaches our Sr. Specialists and Engineering is already vetted.

Because many of the reports you're investigating come from riders or drivers who had a genuinely bad experience, this role also requires direct, empathetic communication with customers. You're often the person following up on an issue that upset them.

This role is part of a new HQ Associate model based in Mexico, built to bring bug review in-house with tighter tooling access, stronger quality control, and closer partnership with the broader teams. Associates report directly into the Customer Impact structure.

Responsibilities


Investigate and triage incoming bug reports against defined criteria (reproducibility, severity, customer impact)
Open bug tickets in Jira and document investigation findings clearly and accurately for each case
Apply consistent quality and documentation standards so escalations are engineering-ready
Meet daily/weekly productivity targets (ticket volume and average handle time) while maintaining accuracy)
Flag patterns or recurring issues to Sr. Associates or Sr. Specialists for further investigation
Use internal tools (Zendesk, Amazon Connect, Sentry, and related platforms) to gather evidence and context for each ticket
Escalate ambiguous or high-severity cases
Participate in calibration sessions and ongoing training to stay aligned with evolving bug review standards
Meet/exceed efficiency and customer satisfaction KPIs


Experience 


Minimun of one (1) year of experience in technical support, QA, bug triage, or a similar investigative/customer-facing role
Comfort working within ticketing systems (Jira, Zendesk, or similar) and following structured workflows
Experience working in a fast-paced environment, while also being efficient with their time, and detail oriented
Strong attention to detail and ability to follow documented investigation criteria consistently
You truly care about Lyft’s mission, and the happiness and success of our customers
Impeccable communication skills. Your communication style conveys empathy and complex instructions warmly, succinctly, and with flawless spelling and grammar
Ability to manage a high-volume queue while maintaining quality and meeting productivity targets
A zest for problem-solving. You enjoy applying your own knowledge and inquisitiveness towards helping others by actively listening, asking thoughtful questions, and methodically working towards a solution
Analytical curiosity. You naturally synthesize inputs from individual customer issues to identify trends
Basic familiarity with mobile app ecosystems (iOS/Android) is a plus
Reliable, self-motivated, and comfortable with repetitive, process-driven work at scale
Preferred
Exposure to bug/defect tracking in a rideshare, marketplace, or consumer tech environment

Nuestro motor de crecimiento necesita a alguien que lo construya y lo escale. Buscamos un Senior Growth Marketing Manager con historial comprobable de funnels construidos desde cero y que entienda que en un marketplace de dos lados, crecer la demanda y la oferta van de la mano. Si tu trayectoria habla de resultados medibles, ownership real y una obsesión sana por los datos, sigue leyendo.




El desafío

Este no es un puesto de marketing tradicional. Eres el arquitecto del crecimiento de PartRunner en ambos lados del marketplace: el responsable de construir la máquina que atrae, convierte y retiene tanto a los clientes enterprise y mid-market que necesitan mover carga grande, como a los transportistas y flotas que hacen posible cada entrega.

Operarás con autonomía real y visibilidad directa a la Dirección. Usarás datos para decidir, IA para escalar y creatividad para diferenciarte en un mercado que PR está definiendo.

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

We are looking for a highly motivated intern with a strong quantitative background — ideally studying Economics or a related field — who is genuinely excited about data, AI, and communications. This role offers a unique opportunity to help optimize the Measurement and Insights capability for External Affairs globally at one of the fastest-growing tech companies.

In this position, you will focus on leveraging data to support Communications, Government Affairs, and Internal Communications teams across DiDi’s global markets. You’ll be expected to go beyond running numbers — we’re looking for someone who can interpret data, surface key findings, and proactively identify opportunities to use AI and automation to make our work sharper and faster. If you’re the kind of person who figures things out on your own, builds before being asked, and is always thinking about how to do things better, this role is for you.

In this role, you'll be...

Support Communications, Government Affairs, and Internal Communications teams by running data queries and surfacing relevant insights to inform media narratives and stakeholder communications.

Coordinate efforts to maintain our measurement systems optimized and up to date.
Develop measurement strategies for projects from the ground up and maintain up-to-date databases and trackers.
Generate materials to help teams better understand our metrics (infographics, presentations, glossaries, dashboards).
Proactively identify opportunities to implement AI tools and automation to enhance team efficiency and the quality of output.
Stay informed about new AI and social listening developments and bring concrete proposals to the team.
Keep tabs on the area’s deliverables, trackers, and prioritizations to ensure we are always working at our highest potential.
Provide basic training to team members on our measurement systems and tools.
Be a reliable, committed team member: own your work, meet deadlines, and follow through.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

The successful candidate will have:


Studying a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Finance, or a related field with a strong quantitative component.
Strong Spanish and English communication skills (both written and verbal) — essential.
A genuine interest in AI and a track record of learning and implementing new tools independently.
Proactive, self-taught mindset.
Data-driven thinking with the ability to interpret results and translate them into clear, actionable insights.
Interest in measurement, social listening tools, communications, and technology.
Organized, results-oriented, and committed.
Empathic team player, eager to collaborate and willing to learn many new systems quickly.
Knowledge of Python and/or SQL (basic analysis, cleaning, automation)..
Schedule availability in the mornings, hybrid work model (1–2 days at the office).



Come join us to:


Join a strong, collaborative, and fun Central External Affairs team.
Do hands-on, impactful work for DiDi’s global markets and all business lines.
Learn about cutting-edge social listening tools that harness the power of AI.
Work in an environment that will strengthen your professional abilities and set you on the right path for a bright future.
Unlock mentorship opportunities.
Base salary and law benefits.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. Are you an experienced Vietnamese voice actor eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models and speech technologies are evolving rapidly, moving beyond simple interactions into expressive, human-like communication. Fluency in Vietnamese is required, along with demonstrated experience in professional voice acting, dubbing, narration, or related performance work. Experience in training, coaching, or linguistic annotation is a plus. Clear communication skills and attention to detail are essential. A high-quality recording setup—including a reliable microphone and a quiet environment—is required.

Ready to channel your Vietnamese voice expertise into building the AI voices of tomorrow? Apply today and help shape the model that will speak to millions around the world.

We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. description:
About the job

Are you an experienced voice actor eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models and speech technologies are evolving rapidly, moving beyond simple interactions into expressive, human-like communication. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can deliver more natural, accurate, and engaging voice experiences across education, entertainment, accessibility, and beyond. That training data begins with you—your voice expertise will help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for a highly skilled voice acting professional who can bring nuance, clarity, and authenticity to training data in Finnish. You’ll work with cutting-edge AI tools, record and evaluate speech samples, and provide expert feedback on pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional variation to strengthen Finnish voice models.

On a typical day, you will record scripted material in Finnish, assess AI-generated outputs for linguistic accuracy and naturalness, annotate errors, and collaborate with our team to refine prompts, evaluation methods, and voice design guidelines.

Demonstrated experience in professional voice acting, dubbing, narration, or related performance work in Finnish is required. Experience in training, coaching, or linguistic annotation is a plus. Clear communication skills and attention to detail are essential. A high-quality recording setup—including a reliable microphone and a quiet environment—is required.

Ready to channel your Finnish voice expertise into building the AI voices of tomorrow? Apply today and help shape the model that will speak to millions around the world.

We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer, high-quality microphone and recording setup, and stable internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

description:
About the job

Role Description

As a Senior Fullstack Product Software Engineer on Dropbox’s Browse & Navigate Web Experience team, you will own and evolve the customer-facing web experiences and supporting systems behind Browse, Navigate, Preview, and related workflows. You will lead ambiguous, multi-phase work from technical discovery and design through rollout and operational ownership, partnering with Product, Design, Data, Infrastructure, and platform teams. You will combine full-stack execution with sound architecture, production judgment, and approved AI-assisted workflows while remaining accountable for final technical quality.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities


Own multi-phase full-stack product capabilities from requirements and technical design through staged rollout, measurement, and ongoing operation.
Design and evolve scalable web experiences, services, APIs, and data models for Browse, Navigate, Preview, App Shell, window chrome, and shared web capabilities.
Make architecture and scope tradeoffs that balance customer needs, delivery constraints, reliability, performance, security, privacy, and maintainability.
Improve observability, testing, incident readiness, and on-call health, and lead debugging and production-risk decisions when systems fail.
Use approved AI and automation tools for implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and operational workflows; validate outputs and standardize practices that preserve engineering quality.
Align cross-team dependencies and create leverage through reusable components and services, design and code reviews, runbooks, technical documentation, and mentoring.


Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements


9+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience building full-stack product systems, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience designing, shipping, and operating large-scale, customer-facing web applications and multi-component systems.
Strong frontend engineering skills with TypeScript or JavaScript and modern web frameworks such as React, plus experience with at least one backend language such as Python, Go, Java, or C++.
Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of ambiguous, multi-phase initiatives, including adjusting scope based on customer, business, and technical constraints.
Experience making architecture tradeoffs across frontend systems, APIs, data models, reliability, performance, observability, and production operations.
Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, codebases, and approved AI or automation workflows while validating generated output for correctness, security, privacy, and maintainability.
Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly and align dependencies across Engineering, Product, Design, Data, Infrastructure, and platform partners.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with large-scale content, file, collaboration, or productivity systems.
Deep experience with React and TypeScript together with backend APIs, services, and data modeling.
Experience with AI-assisted product experiences, recommendation systems, or operational automation.
Experience leading cross-team migrations, staged rollouts, or platform integrations and improving SLOs, observability, or test strategy.


Durable Skills

Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:


Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.


To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Company Description

Read more about our benefits here.

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.

Team Description

The Dropbox Engineering Team develops the technology, platforms, and products that create more enlightened ways of working for hundreds of millions of people. Customers rely on Dropbox to manage, share, and collaborate on content seamlessly—our engineering makes that easier and more intuitive than ever before.Our platform features a robust systems software layer that stores and processes exabytes of data, and a suite of growing services that enhance core products like our sharing and sync engine. We’re also driving innovation with new offerings such as Dash, our AI-powered knowledge management engine. Our infrastructure spans high-performance servers and cutting-edge components across multiple data centers worldwide, ensuring reliability, speed, and scalability at a global scale. We think like a startup but build for an enterprise, exploring new possibilities that transform how people work. If you're excited about turning complex technical challenges into intuitive solutions at scale, join our Engineering team.

Virtual First

Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.

This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5-10% of the year or 2-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.

AI Fluency

AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.

We Look For Four Key Behaviors In Candidates


Ownership: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
Experimentation: You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
Leverage: You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
Learning: You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.


Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.

Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted. To learn more, see our approach to AI in hiring.

Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

About Us - Malvern Panalytical, Micromeritics And SciAps.

Together we are a powerful and highly complementary combination of market leading technologies.

We are the toolmakers for the world's most innovative companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories. We are their partners in discovery.

Malvern Panalytical instruments analyze the chemical, physical and structural nature of materials, from proteins to polymers and semiconductors to minerals. Our leading technologies measure particle size, shape, concentration and zeta potential, biomolecular interactions and stability, elemental concentrations and crystallographic structure.

Micromeritics manufactures systems for the characterization of particles, powders, and porous materials for a wide- range of end markets including catalysts, chemicals, building materials, clean-tech and battery. SciAps specializes in portable X-ray fluorescence (XRF), laser-based (LIBS) and near-infrared (NIR) analyzers to measure any element in any environment. SciAps is the Center of Excellence for our handheld instruments.

We have a global footprint with R&D and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.

description:
About the job

Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $607,000 - $789,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $607,000 - $744,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of — together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.


Client: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.


People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.


Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. 


Qualifications


You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.
You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.
You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.
You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.
You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

description:
About the job

Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $607,000 - $789,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $607,000 - $744,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of — together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.


Client: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.


People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.


Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. 


Qualifications


You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.
You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.
You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.
You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.
You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

About the job

Job Description

About GMNS Products (formerly, Network & Acquirer Solutions)

GMNS Products (formerly, NAS) is leading the effort to modernize our acquiring ecosystem and strengthen regulatory and controls across GMNS. GMNS Products is leading the modernization of American Express’s acquiring ecosystem while strengthening regulatory, control, and compliance execution across GMNS. As part of this transformation, we are standing up a centralized PMO to manage a high volume of control and compliance mandates and convert fragmented demand into a disciplined, transparent operating model.

Responsibilities

Role Summary

Reporting to the Director, Digital Product Operations — PMO, Mandates, the Manager, Digital Product Operations will play a critical role in operating and scaling the mandates PMO. This role is responsible for managing day-to-day intake, analysis, tracking, and reporting of control and compliance requests, ensuring high data quality, execution discipline, and stakeholder transparency.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role requiring strong organizational skills, attention to detail, comfort with technical and regulatory requirements, and the ability to partner effectively across Product, Technology, Compliance, Control Management, and Delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities

Mandates Intake & Operational Management


 Manage the day-to-day intake and triage of incoming mandates (control, compliance, regulatory, and high-priority asks).
 Ensure requests are properly documented, categorized, and routed using established PMO standards.
 Maintain a high-quality, up-to-date inventory of mandates, owners, dependencies, and status.


Prioritization & Execution Support


 Apply defined prioritization frameworks to score and sequence requests.
 Support the Director in preparing recommended delivery waves and capacity views.

title: Nights Transportation Assistant
description:
About the job

Position Description

Nights Transportation Assistant | Remote | Full-Time | Monday – Friday, 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM CST

White Star Logistics is growing rapidly and remains committed to sustained expansion. As part of this growth, the organization has set a milestone of delivering 1,000,000 loads. Achieving this goal requires a Nights Transportation Assistant capable of coordinating cross-border freight and maintaining the carrier capacity and documentation accuracy needed to scale accordingly.

This position carries significant coordination and compliance responsibility: preparing and auditing cross-border documentation, dispatching loads with consistency, and serving as the go-to connection between carriers, customers, and internal teams overnight. This role is intended for a motivated, detail-driven transportation professional, someone who will help protect the carrier network and compliance standing necessary for the company's next phase of growth.

Candidates with a demonstrated record of managing cross-border freight documentation and thriving in a fast-paced, overnight environment, and who are ready to take ownership as part of a growing team, are encouraged to apply.

We Are Looking For:

• 3 years of freight brokerage experience – Candidates know cross-border freight operations thoroughly and bring a proven track record.

• Bilingual fluency – Fluent in English and Spanish, both verbal and written.

• Documentation expertise – Hands-on knowledge of Carta Porte, DODA, and related customs documents.

• Multitasking skills – Thrives when managing multiple active loads and exceptions in a fast-paced environment.

• TMS platform experience – Comfortable maintaining accurate, audit-ready shipment records.

• Strong communicator – Clear, confident, and able to build trusted carrier relationships.

• Independent operator – Comfortable owning the overnight shift with no one else online.

What You Will Do:

• Coordinate and dispatch loads – Intra-U.S. and cross-border, including drayage, transloads, and door-to-door moves, with sound carrier sourcing, rate negotiation, and load coverage.

• Prepare and audit documentation – BOLs, Carta Porte, DODA, Commercial Invoices, and customs entries, catching issues before they become a customs hold.

• Manage overnight exceptions – Serve as the overnight point of contact for internal teams, carriers, and clients, managing detentions, delays, and escalations with confidence.

• Build and protect carrier capacity – Maintain trusted carrier relationships to protect coverage during peak or disrupted lanes.

• Maintain TMS records – Keep shipment records accurate, current, and audit-ready.

• Track U.S. domestic freight – Monitor and communicate shipment status across U.S. domestic freight alongside cross-border loads.

Qualifications:

• 1–3 years of 3PL brokerage experience – Required, with a proven track record in the industry.

• Bilingual fluency – Ability to communicate in English and Spanish via phone and written documentation.

• Cross-border documentation expertise – Carta Porte, DODA, and related customs entries.

• Strong work ethic – Drive and focus to own the shift independently overnight.

• TMS platform experience – Prior hands-on use of a transportation management system preferred.

• Freight mode experience – FTL, intermodal, or drayage preferred.

Core Values:

• Own It – We take responsibility for outcomes, not excuses.

• Find a Way – We are resourceful, resilient, and solution-oriented.

• Protect All Stakeholders – We protect customers, employees, carriers, vendors, and the company.

• Communicate Early – We communicate proactively, particularly when issues arise.

• Excellence Through Growth – We continuously pursue improvement across our team, ourselves, and our service.

• Develop People – We believe our greatest contribution is helping people realize more than they believed possible.

Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.
